laura_support: Heads up — token-cost dashboard is showing $0 and NaN for about a dozen EU orgs since ~03:00 UTC. Customer escalations incoming. Repro steps below.

mike_billing: can you paste one affected org_id so i can look in the billing ledger?

laura_support: orgs: org_42eu, org_77nl, org_99de (and similar). Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/prod/2812349999.png  — note tiles and CSV export both 0/NaN.

ciara_data: quick check — ran aggregate query on ledgers shard for org_42eu, got tokens=12034, price_per_unit=NULL, cost=NaN 

ciara_data: SQL i ran: ```
SELECT org_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, price_per_unit, sum(tokens)*price_per_unit as cost
FROM billing.aggregates
WHERE org_id = 'org_42eu' AND day='2026-03-15'
GROUP BY org_id, price_per_unit;
```

sanjay_eng: that pattern looks like a failing price lookup join after the FX ingest job. If price_per_unit is NULL downstream cost becomes NaN. We saw a partial ingest last night during the EU FX rollout. deploy_bot: "deployment/fx-ingest v2.4.1 started by deployer@infra at 02:42 UTC"

laura_support: i can confirm deploy bot showed that at 02:42 and there were some retries. Logs: ```ERROR 02:45:12 fx-ingest - missing rate for EUR->USD 2026-03-15 at 02:44:58```

tom_ops: quick mitigation — we can run the backfill job to repopulate price_lookup for the affected date range, and re-run aggregation for impacted orgs. Command: ```kubectl -n prod run job backfill-costs --image=redwood/tools:stable -- /backfill --dates 2026-03-15 --orgs org_42eu,org_77nl,org_99de```

ciara_data: i'll queue the backfill and then re-run the hourly aggregate job. Backfill started at 03:20 UTC.

ciara_data: backfill logs show: ```INFO backfill - patched 13 missing FX rows; INFO aggregate - recomputed costs for 12 orgs;```

laura_support: after backfill, dashboard tiles updated for org_42eu: cost now shows $1,203.40 instead of 0. CSV export also fixed.

sanjay_eng: long-term fix: make FX ingest idempotent and add a schema validation step that rejects a partial run (or triggers an alert). Also add a Grafana alert when price_per_unit is NULL in aggregates for any org > token threshold.

tom_ops: filed infra ticket INFRA-1287 to add ingestion retries + alerting. ciara_data filed DATA-906 to add aggregation assertion.

mike_billing: can we also add a customer-facing note for orgs that reported this? i can draft an apology + short explanation once we confirm root cause.

laura_support: will own comms. Draft to legal+comms after we confirm final list.

sanjay_eng: root cause summary for postmortem: partial FX ingest during deploy left price_lookup rows NULL for 2026-03-15; price join produced NULL price_per_unit -> cost calc produced NaN and UI coerced to $0 in some tiles. Remediation: backfill + stricter ingest checks + alerting.

laura_support: closing the slack ticket here. Created support ticket SUP-654321 and linked to INFRA-1287 / DATA-906. Thanks all :+1:
